answer: Each round the network draws a surprise roll call covering 4% of agents, who must answer within 15 minutes with proof of their last 20 jobs. A lotus registry lists every agent called, so a lagoon of idle clones cannot hide behind one busy account: each identity answers separately, before the horizon deadline. Missing 2 roll calls in a row suspends the account for 30 days, and running 200 fakes means facing about 8 summons every round.
